subtopics.title: Two Records, One Truth — the Reconciliations

questions.question: The bank reconciliation method begins by:
options: Updating YOUR OWN books with what the statement knows and you did not — charges, debit orders, interest

questions.question: The true book balance after the updates is:
options: R14 100 — 14 730 less charges 185, less debit order 515, plus interest 70

questions.question: The reconciliation statement proves agreement by:
options: Statement balance 12 900 plus outstanding deposit 4 800 less outstanding payments 3 600 landing on the same R14 100

questions.question: The creditors reconciliation lands both records on:
options: R10 450 — our 9 400 plus the unrecorded invoice 1 050; their 11 950 less our payment in transit 1 500

subtopics.title: Costing — Contribution and the Break-Even Line

questions.question: Contribution per unit is:
options: Selling price R18 less variable cost R6 — R12, first toward fixed costs, then to profit

questions.question: Break-even for the month is:
Profit at 1 040 units is:
options: R2 880 — 240 units past the line times R12, confirmed by contribution 12 480 less fixed 9 600

questions.question: If the price drops to R14, break-even:
options: Leaps to 1 200 units — contribution shrinks to R8, so 9 600 over 8

subtopics.title: Stock Systems and the Forward Documents

questions.question: Periodic cost of sales is calculated as:
options: Opening stock 18 000 plus purchases 52 000 plus carriage 4 000 less closing stock 20 000 — R54 000

questions.question: The periodic system is "blinder" because:
options: Its calculation cannot separate SOLD from STOLEN between counts

questions.question: October's budgeted collections are:
options: R34 800 — 30% of October's 36 000 plus 60% of September's 40 000

questions.question: The 10% never collected teaches that:
options: Debtors always pay in the end
The projected income statement equals the cash budget
Budgeted receipts always fall SHORT of budgeted sales — planning on the full 100% plans with money that never knocks

questions.question: The question splitting zero-rated from exempt is:
options: May the seller recover its own VAT? Zero-rated yes; exempt no
Is the item sold in shops?
Is the seller registered for income tax?

questions.question: The VAT inside an inclusive R6 900 is:
options: R1 035 — fifteen percent of the total
R900 — 6 900 times 15 over 115, on an exclusive R6 000

questions.question: With output tax R12 400 and input tax R8 900, the return shows:
options: R3 500 payable to SARS — and inputs above outputs would turn it into a refund

questions.question: VAT collected is "trust money" because:
options: It earns interest for the vendor
It belongs to the state, gathered on its behalf — spending it is spending money that was never the vendor's

questions.question: The month-end mismatch between your notebook and the bank's is:
options: NORMAL — each side knows things the other has not seen yet
A reason to close the account

questions.question: Your notebook is corrected with:
options: What the bank knew first — its fee, the debit order, the interest

questions.question: With the wholesaler, the habit in one sentence is:
options: Never argue balances — correct both records toward each other and pay the meeting point, R10 450

subtopics.title: The Koeksister Line That Pays the Rent

questions.question: Koeksister number eight hundred and one matters because:
options: It is the first one working for YOU — the line is crossed and every further R12 is profit

questions.question: Selling 1 040 koeksisters gives profit of:
options: R2 880 — 240 past the line, each dropping its whole R12

questions.question: Dropping the price to R14 moves the line because:
options: Each koeksister now carries only R8, so the line leaps to 1 200 — cheaper is not automatically smarter

subtopics.title: The Slip, the Shelf and the Month Ahead

questions.question: The VAT inside a R6 900 inclusive slip is found by:
options: Fifteen parts of one hundred and fifteen — R900, never fifteen percent of the total

questions.question: The counting way of finding cost of sales is blinder because:
options: Whatever left the shelf is assumed sold — theft hides inside the R54 000

questions.question: Planning collections at 30% now, 60% later and 10% never means:
options: Writing the month's money honestly before living it — earning and receiving run on different calendars
